events.title: Israeli police deploy rooftop snipers in Bedouin city of Rahat
events.summary: Israeli police deploy rooftop snipers in Bedouin city of Rahat Israeli police have stationed snipers on rooftops in Rahat, a Bedouin city in southern Israel, saying they would “neutralise” gunmen who open fire. The deployment follows reports of heavy daytime gunfire and the reported discovery of weapons caches in the area.

events.title: Report: Centcom denies Israeli reports of possible renewed war on Iran
events.summary: Report: Centcom denies Israeli reports of possible renewed war on Iran The US military has denied an Israeli media report that indicated it is preparing for possible renewed attacks on Iran, Anadolu Agency reported. A US Central Command (Centcom) official told the news agency that there were no updates regarding the US force posture in the Middle East, dismissing the claims as "pure speculation".
